    """ Returns the deepest level of nesting of the parentheses in the string

    >>> parse_parens('(()())')
    2
    >>> parse_parens('((()))')
    3
    """
    assert all(char in {'(', ')'} for char in paren_string)
    depth, max_depth = 0, 0
    for char in paren_string:
        if char == '(':
            depth += 1
            max_depth = max(max_depth, depth)
        else:  # char == ')'
            depth -= 1
    assert depth == 0
    return max_depth
